scope: Tool/context/verification microbenchmark. Does not measure implementation or judge game quality.

tasks.scenario: Change a stock gameplay condition; game-only edits use check --game instead.
Change asset discovery or validation; content still requires its authored asset/scenario gate.
Extend reusable path behavior and its unit tests.
Change replication behavior and prove dependent netplay/hub scenarios.
Extend a portable starter; fresh-agent trial measures creating a game.
Modify isolated package verification without rebuilding renderer code.
Update revision/migration verification; game gates must run fresh.

agent_trial.task: Create a polished portable 2D game from the recommended starter: five artifacts, locked exit, timer loss, restart, save/load, distinct visual treatment. Assert win/loss/collision/save continuation, inspect frames, build and fully verify the local browser package; do not publish externally.
agent_trial.rules: Fresh checkout/context, same model/task/quality rubric. Report warmed caches and unsupported telemetry; a blocked baseline cannot support an end-to-end speedup percentage. Never skip final gates or fabricate public source origins.
